sample_unit: participants (44 patients, 13 nurses, 3 nursing managers, 2 surgeons, 1 psychologist, 1 dietitian)

links.outcome: Answer accuracy and RAG knowledge hit rate across three alpha-testing rounds
links.effect: Accuracy 67% (37/55), 71% (44/62), 82% (31/38); RAG knowledge hit rates 86%, 98%, 100%; hit-rate differences significant (P<.01). No non-RAG comparator.
links.quote: The accuracy of the agent in 3 rounds was 67% (37/55), 71% (44/62), and 82% (31/38), respectively; RAG knowledge hit rates reached 86% (47/55), 98% (61/62), and 100% (38/38).

unlisted_practices: Action research approach to iteratively develop a patient education chatbot with stakeholder participation

screen.reason: Empirical study describing the development, action research deployment, usability, and accuracy testing of a RAG-based LLM conversational agent with patients and clinical staff at a gastric cancer center.
